description: Test suite for the CordRepBtreeReader class in the Abseil library, testing reading, skipping, seeking, and exhaustively reading from a CordRepBtree data structure.

classes.name: CordRepBtreeReader
classes.description: A class for reading data from a CordRepBtree structure, supporting sequential read, skip, seek, and read with offset.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next chunk of data from the reader.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of bytes in the data stream.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the data stream and returns the corresponding chunk.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the current position, possibly returning a partial chunk.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the reader with a CordRepBtree node.
